'''Fen Teak''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Artist/Legends|painter]], whose portraits bore an unmistakable style, and who was considered brilliant by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. By [[980 BBY]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] had acquired several of Teak's portraits and set them for display in [[Set Harth's mansion|his mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fen Teak was mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'' written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]]. Teak's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] was not established.<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />
